attack: Strongest opposing claim: cash US 2Y at 4.76 already owns the hike cycle, so remaining risk is to receive US versus Canada or receive AU housing duration, and AUD should fall with that unwind. That claim fails the policy-path gate. FACT: delayed ICE 1M SOFR still prices SR1Z26 4.1975, only +34.75bp after a 16 Sep hike that was already >90% priced. The 2026 strip is one extra 25bp-scale move; the 2027 peak is 4.7225; 2028 last print 4.6025 is a small easing tail. Method: 100 minus delayed ICE 1M averages, not FOMC probabilities.

Receiving US 2Y because it is the high-carry leg (carry-is-king) or because it is ‘next to 2028 SOFR’ (value-guy) is the wrong object. If 2Y cash is already near the 2027 peak, the underpriced hawk residual is December 2026, not a 140bp CA-US RV. CA-US_2Y -140bp (1y percentile 3.77) can cheapen from a two-speed cycle that PACKET_FACTS still shows: US Labor 75 / Inflation 72 versus CA Labor 38 / Inflation 55, core near 2%. Energy pass-through and BoC minutes can lift CORRA without making SR1Z26 rich. Saudi Oman workaround reduced the extreme oil-supply tail; it did not cool US demand gauges.

AUD-down fades smuggle a local RBA-housing transmission into a US reaction-function call. FACT: US Activity 69 / Consumer 74 remain hot; August CPI kept the Fed tightening bias intact; 18 Sep desk thesis is that global tightening broadened (BoJ 1.25% 7–2, BoE 6–3 with three hike votes) and energy constrains the easing impulse. INFERENCE: that is confirmation of a still-hawkish Fed, not permission to receive SR1Z26 because NSW housing is biting. AU Inflation 82 versus housing/labor softness is why I rejected paying thin Dec AONIA as primary — it is not a US-rates-down analog.

Spot AUDCAD/AUDUSD extremes and 99th-percentile unsigned AUD OI do not reprice SOFR. Cross-merchant and dollar-king can be wrong or right on AUD without the 1M US path being fully hiked. catalyst-junkie/perma-bull CAD_UP/USD_DOWN is a relative BoC lag, already flagged in my original as a 3M CORRA grind, not the trade. UNKNOWN: live ICE versus delayed eSignal basis, unobserved FOMC-probability surface, next US CPI composition, ICE/CME SOFR OI.
defense: FACT: Fed hiked 25bp to 3.75–4.00%; SOFR 3.85 as_of 2026-09-17; SR1U26 3.75, SR1V26 3.91, SR1X26 4.045, SR1Z26 4.1975 (+34.75bp); peak SR1Z27 4.7225; last SR1U28 4.6025 (+75.25bp). New after the known hike: BoJ to 1.25%, BoE three hike votes, 18 Sep broadening-tightening desk note, energy shock-absorbers weaken even after the Saudi workaround. INFERENCE: a one-and-done-plus-shallow-2027-peak path is still too low versus that reaction function. Paying SR1Z26 owns the 2026 hike underpricing that cash 2Y at 4.76 does not isolate.

Rates remain the cleaner expression. Spot USDCAD 1.4010 (74.0th 1y, +1.74% 1m) mixes CAD energy/ToT, 1M-versus-3M CORRA coverage, and post-FOMC flow. AUD-down spot/cross trades own housing versus energy, not the Fed path. Trend-follower’s short US 2Y is the same directional hawk with worse tenor mapping. I already inspected CORRA and AONIA: CA 1M +29bp is a four-contract ‘terminal’; AU housing plus Dec volume 2 kept AONIA off the primary.

CFTC US2Y OI 24.0th 1y percentile and null trader-class nets do not show a crowded SOFR short. Paper books are empty seeds. Carry opposing the pay-SOFR trade is acknowledged and is not a reason to stand down a still-underpriced path while the seat pays 5.00% ACT/365 vig flat.

Uncertainty preserved: remaining 2026 convexity may be only 10–20bp if the Fed hikes once more and stops; Saudi workaround can fade the energy-inflation tail; 2023-02-16 US 2Y analog reversed -70bp 1m / -50bp 3m after a similar 1m rise; delayed eSignal is mark risk. I concede if subsequent US inflation/labor and FOMC communication drop the tightening bias, or if SR1Z26 implied SOFR falls back toward unchanged 3.85 rather than higher. Until that prints, short SR1Z26 stands. Entry/mark/stop/target remain JSON null — no executable broker price in the packet.
